final: SELECT AVG(avg_minutes), AVG(avg_fee_per_day), AVG(avg_fee_per_day - overall_avg_fee_per_day) FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_minutes, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_fee_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating) AS rating_avgs CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_per_day) AS overall_avg_fee_per_day FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_fee_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating) AS per_rating) AS overall_avg WHERE avg_fee_per_day IS NOT NULL AND overall_avg_fee_per_day IS NOT NULL AND avg_fee_per_day > overall_avg_fee_per_day
